environment.description: EKS cluster (v1.28) in us-east-1. The user-service pod runs in the 'platform' namespace behind an internal NLB (scheme=internal). Ingress is controlled by a combination of: (1) VPC security group sg-0a4f8e2c1b on the NLB target group allowing inbound TCP/50051 only from CIDR 10.200.0.0/16 and 172.20.4.0/22 (corporate egress NAT ranges for the SRE and platform-eng teams), (2) a Cilium CiliumNetworkPolicy in the 'platform' namespace with an ingress rule specifying fromCIDR [10.200.0.0/16, 172.20.4.0/22] on port 50051 and denying all other ingress, (3) the NLB is not internet-facing (internal scheme, no public DNS record, only resolvable via Route53 private hosted zone associated with the VPC). The MongoDB instance uses SCRAM-SHA-256 auth and the app credentials have readOnly role on the 'userdb' database only.
